1.name: AND Gate
1.desc: Outputs ON when all the inputs are ON.

2.name: NAND Gate
2.desc: Outputs ON when all the inputs are OFF.

3.name: NOR Gate
3.desc: Outputs ON when at least one input is OFF.

4.name: NOT Gate
4.desc: Outputs ON when the input is OFF.

5.name: OR Gate
5.desc: Outputs ON when at least one input is ON.

6.name: Splitter
6.desc: Splits the input value into 2 outputs.

7.name: XNOR Gate
7.desc: Outputs ON when the number of ON inputs are even.

8.name: XOR Gate
8.desc: Outputs ON when the number of ON inputs are odd.

9.name: Counter
9.desc: When triggered, the counter will count up or down depending of the input choosen. You can chain them by connecting the [- output] or [+ output] to the input of another counter.

10.name: 8 Bit Shifter Counter
10.desc: This counter shifts one bit to the right or left. 8 bits.

11.name: Number Counter
11.desc: When triggered, the counter will stop counting at 9 (Decimal), insted of 15 (Hexadecimal). You can use the [- Output] or [+ Output] to chain multiple counters. Useful to display numbers.

12.name: Color No Light
12.desc: Unlike other lights, this light only changes color, emitting no light.

13.name: Gated SR Latch
13.desc: When [clk] is triggered, the latch will change state hange state according to the ON input. If both inputs are activated, it will toggle itself.

14.name: Full Adder
14.desc: This adder adds all the ON inputs as a 1 and output the corresponding value.

15.name: SR Latch
15.desc: Set 1 input to ON to trigger the latch on one side.

16.name: Toggle Output
16.desc: This block toggles itself when the input is triggered.

17.name: Delay
17.desc: The Delay [Repeater] wait until a certain amout of time until it realeases the pulse you sent.

18.name: Timer
18.desc: When set to ON, the Timer will create a timing loop of ON/OFF according to the delay choosen.

19.name: Randomizer
19.desc: When enabled, this component will output randomly from the Mode slected. Click to change from Mode [01 10] to [10 01 11]!

20.name: Wifi
20.desc: Useful to hide wires. The output number corresponds to the input number.

21.name: Button
21.desc: Outputs when an allowed player clicks on the button.

23.name: Lever
23.desc: Outputs when the Lever is toggled by an allowed player.

24.name: Toggle Button
24.desc: [OLD STUFF!] Outputs when the Button is toggled by an allowed player.

25.name: Instant Button
25.desc: Unlike the normal Button, this one can be triggered faster.

26.name: HEX Color Display
26.desc: This display is useful to display numbers in Hexadecimal (0-F).

27.name: HEX Squared Color Display
27.desc: This display is useful to display numbers in Hexadecimal (0-F). It has a square look.

28.name: HEX LCD Display
28.desc: This display is useful to display numbers in Hexadecimal (0-F). It has a LCD look.

29.name: HEX Pixel Color Display
29.desc: This display is useful to display numbers in Hexadecimal (0-F). It has a pixelated look.

31.name: Read Output
31.desc: [OLD STUFF!] This component reads the input and display the value.

34.name: RGB Light
34.desc: Light that can mix Red Green and Blue.

36.name: Invisible Block
36.desc: This block is invisible and collidable.

42.name: _Legacy Kill Module
42.desc: Old Kill Module. Used to remove health from players. Click on it for settings.

51.name: Color Neon Light 2
51.desc: A light that when turned on, glows. Otherwise, the light is black.

54.name: Piston
54.desc: This non-sticky piston can push movable blocks. It cannot move itself when powered.

70.name: 4 Bit Shifter Counter
70.desc: This counter shifts one bit to the right or left. 4 bits.

73.name: Text Panel
73.desc: A simple panel that lets you write all english and french common characters.

74.name: 2 Bit Multiplier
74.desc: A really old block used to multiply 2 bits.

75.name: Door
75.desc: A clickable door. How to place two doors: Place the first one, then rotate the second one so that it is already in the open position when placed.

76.name: Electric Door
76.desc: A powered door. How to place two electric doors: Place the first one, then rotate the second one so that it is already in the open position when placed.

77.name: Sticky Piston
77.desc: This sticky piston can push movable blocks, and retract them. It cannot move itself when powered.

79.name: Empty Block
79.desc: A non-collidable block that can be used to break tnt impact.

126.name: Phosphor Light
126.desc: A light that uses phosphor to glow!

133.name: Physics Block
133.desc: [ALPHA] Activate to transform a region into physics!

141.name: _Legacy Player Detector
141.desc: A component that can be used to get the amount of players in a certain region. This is the legacy version, please use the recent version.

150.name: HTTP Transmitter
150.desc: Using the web, this transmitter can transmit POST requests and GET requests. Make your own API in order to make it work!

153.name: Junction Block
153.desc: Allows several blocks of different colors to interconnect.

154.name: Stair Chair
154.desc: A chair that can be combined with stairs!

155.name: Solid Chair
155.desc: A ticker version of the original chair!

156.name: Slab Chair
156.desc: A chair that looks like a slab!

158.name: _Legacy Keypad
158.desc: Useful to lock your doors! (Legacy version, no code encoding)

161.name: Illegal Piston
161.desc: This illegal piston can push activated pistons!

162.name: Illegal Sticky Piston
162.desc: This sticky illegal piston can push activated pistons!

170.name: 4 Bit Wifi
170.desc: Useful to hide wires. The output number corresponds to the input number.

171.name: Perfect TNT
171.desc: No particles, parts goes in perfect directions.

172.name: Player Detector
172.desc: A component that can be used to get the amount of players in a certain region.

173.name: Kill Module
173.desc: Removes health from players. Click on it for settings.

178.name: Cake
178.desc: A cake for 3M Visits!!! [or for your own wishes]

193.name: RGB2 Phosphor Light
193.desc: An RGB2 light that uses phosphor to glow!

194.name: 8 Bit Shift Register
194.desc: Bidirectional Shift Register, use L [Left] and R [Right] inputs to chain.

180.name: Block Painter
180.desc: Paint blocks using RGB2, the Painted Color or a saved color!

181.name: 8 Bit Synchronous Randomizer
181.desc: An 8 bit synchronous randomizer [that requires a pulse to update] with a custom 8 bit max value!

182.name: Precise Synchronous Randomizer
182.desc: A precise synchronous randomizer [that requires a pulse to update] which you can configure by clicking on it!

195.name: Synchronous Randomizer
195.desc: When pulsed, this component will output randomly from the Mode slected. Click to change from Mode [01 10] to [10 01 11]!

196.name: Precise Randomizer
196.desc: A precise randomizer which you can configure by clicking on it!
